figurative_meaning_bn: একআঁটি; গণনাযোগ্য বা ধারণযোগ্য কিছু বস্তুরসমষ্টি
figurative_meaning_en: A handful; a countable or conceivable aggregate of some objects
example_sentences_in_english: He had a bunch of flowers in his hand.
A bunch of people gathered at the market.
note: Often used in agrarian contexts but applicable generally
